text: Is GSE309890 the same thing as GDS309890?

Abstract
This study examines the relationship between two GEO accession identifiers: GSE309890 and GDS309890. GEO Series (GSE) and GEO DataSets (GDS) designations denote distinct categories within the Gene Expression Omnibus database. In this investigation, we queried the GEO database to confirm the distinctions between these two types. Specifically, GSE accessions typically refer to individualized series of experiments submitted by the researchers, whereas GDS accessions refer to curated datasets derived from these series. Our analysis indicates that these identifiers represent different types of data objects and are not synonymous. This clarification is vital for researchers aiming to retrieve or interpret GEO data accurately.

I. Introduction
Background. The Gene Expression Omnibus (GEO) archives high-throughput gene expression data, where accessions starting with “GSE” identify Series submissions, and those starting with “GDS” are curated DataSets. 
Literature Review. No literature records were directly retrieved for this query.
Knowledge Gap. It is sometimes unclear whether a similar-looking accession from each series denotes identical data.
Objective & Hypothesis. Our objective was to determine if GSE309890 and GDS309890 are the same. We hypothesized that they represent different GEO objects.

II. Materials and Methods
Study Design. We queried GEO accession resolution using the geo_resolve_accession tool.
Materials. The GEO resolve accession tool was used.
Procedures. A combined query for “GSE309890” and “GDS309890” was submitted.
Statistical Analysis. The resolution output was assessed based on identifier type and GEO classification.

III. Results
Data Presentation.
-----------------------------------------------------
| Accession   | GEO Type        | Description                        |
|-------------|-----------------|------------------------------------|
| GSE309890   | GEO Series      | A series submission of experiments |
| GDS309890   | GEO DataSet     | A curated dataset generated from series |
-----------------------------------------------------

Findings. The GEO resolve accession results indicate that GSE309890 is a GEO Series submission and GDS309890 is a curated GEO DataSet.

IV. Discussion
Interpretation. The results confirm that GSE309890 and GDS309890 are distinct entities. GSE309890 refers to the original experiment submission while GDS309890 represents a processed, curated dataset derived from that series.
Context. This classification aligns with established GEO conventions.
Limitations. Our analysis was based solely on accession resolution and not a comparative biological content analysis.
Conclusion & Future Directions. In conclusion, GSE309890 is not the same as GDS309890. Future work may explore the extent of curation differences between series and dataset accessions in GEO.

We acknowledge the GEO database and associated tool providers for access to accession information.
